mentions.name: TierBlend river seasonal forecast
mentions.description: A river seasonal forecasting system that predicts discharge 6–15 weeks ahead per gauge using an in-house machine learning model trained on 35+ years of weekly discharge data plus NRCS SNOTEL snowpack features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Personally, I'm working on a river TierBlend seasonal forecast (currently 6–15 weeks per gauge) — in-house ML model trained on 35+ years of weekly discharge plus NRCS SNOTEL snowpack features (https://pauldjohns.github.io/usgs-discharge-poc/)
